Provider.description:
Where a branch's harness runs.

Serialized as an object tagged by `kind`, such as `{"kind": "local"}` or
`{"kind": "microsandbox", "image": "...", ...}`.

image.description:
OCI image reference. The harness executable must be installed in it
and on its `PATH`, or named by an absolute guest path in
[`TaskOptions::command`].

pass_env.description:
Variables copied by name from this process into the sandbox, such as
`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Nothing else is: not your login, not your
`HOME`. Names are stored with the branch; values are not.

SandboxOptions.description: A sandboxed harness's image, limits and credentials.

endpoint.description:
The `Control` API, as `https://host:port`, or `http://host:port` on
loopback or with [`SubstrateOptions::insecure`].

router.description:
The router URL of an actor's bridge, with `{atespace}` and `{actor}`
in place of the names: `https://` or `wss://`, or `http://` or
`ws://` on loopback or with [`SubstrateOptions::insecure`].

atespace.description: The atespace actors are created in. Empty means `default`.

template.description:
An actor template that runs `branchyard-bridge` with the public half
of [`SubstrateOptions::key`], with git and the harness installed.

key.description:
The host's bridge signing key, from `branchyard-bridge keygen`. The
path is stored with the branch; the key is not.

workdir.description: Where the worktree is placed in the actor. Empty means `/workspace`.

home.description: The harness's `HOME` in the actor. Empty means `/branchyard/home`.

pass_env.description:
Variables copied by name from this process into the actor, such as
`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Names are stored with the branch; values are
not.

ca.description:
PEM certificate authorities for a TLS `Control` API, and for the
router unless [`SubstrateOptions::router_ca`] is set. Unset trusts
the public roots bundled at build time.

client_cert.description: A PEM client certificate and key for the `Control` API (mutual TLS).

router_ca.description: PEM certificate authorities for a TLS router.

insecure.description:
Allow a `Control` endpoint or router in the clear to a host other
than loopback, sending credentials and code unencrypted.

SubstrateOptions.description:
Where an Agent Substrate cluster is and how a harness runs in it.

Each turn creates an actor from [`SubstrateOptions::template`], copies the
worktree into it at [`SubstrateOptions::workdir`] and the branch's private
home to [`SubstrateOptions::home`], runs the harness there through the
bridge, copies both back and deletes the actor. See `docs/substrate.md`.

secrets.description:
Credentials by the name the harness knows them by, such as
`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or `CODEX_AUTH`. Each harness uses the ones its
provisioner reads; the rest are reported as unused.

auth.description:
The authentication method to use when the secrets allow several,
such as `api-key` or `oauth-token`. Unset: the harness's order.

mcp_servers.description: Stdio MCP servers the harness starts, besides Branchyard's own.

remote_mcp_servers.description: HTTP and SSE MCP servers the harness connects to, where it can.

instructions.description: Standing instructions, besides Branchyard's delegation skill.

model.description:
A model name, or a size alias (`small`, `medium`, `large`,
`extra-large`, or `s`, `m`, `l`, `xl`) where the harness defines one.

Provisioning.description:
What a task asks to have provisioned. Stored with the branch, so it
holds where secrets come from, never their values; every turn resolves
them again.

name.description: The name the harness knows it by.

from.description:
Unset: the variable of the same name, in the environment of the
process that runs the turn (on a server, the server's own table of
secrets decides).

SecretSource.description: Where a secret's value comes from.

SecretFrom.description: A variable or a file on the host that runs the turn.

command.description: Absolute path of the executable, as the harness sees it.

env.description:
Stored with the branch like the rest of the request: not for
secrets. Use [`McpServerSpec::secret_env`] for those.

secret_env.description:
Variables set from the task's secrets, by variable and secret name.
Each turn resolves them with the other secrets; only the names are
stored.

McpServerSpec.description: A stdio MCP server, in a form that is stored and sent over the API.

headers.description: Header name to the name of the secret holding its value.

RemoteMcpSpec.description:

resolved each turn, so no header value is stored.
